title: Scope
description: The part of an extraction one import is of, chosen by its owner (docs/adr/0039-the-scope-of-an-import-is-the-owners-and-is-an-input-to-the-check.md): the ids of the blocks, each once, in the order the extraction has them. It is an input to the cut and to the check and never a field of a conversion, whose maker would then decide what counts as missing. The extraction it is of is named by its revision, the SHA-256 of its canonical text.

blocks.description: At least one block, each once. The order is the extraction's, which a schema cannot say and the tools check.
